## 7ef325b21961

**Generated-domain semantic restriction plus blocking contract defects; target left unchanged.** Generator SHA-256 `2869e1453797898aa152fa2ae4f40afdc1b29576b24cf9c268004b91eb5c0532` chooses `majority = colors[-2]` and `minority = colors[-1]` once per grid, then reuses that same pair for every frame. Consequently, a shortcut can detect all rectangular frames, choose one globally most frequent interior dot color, and fill every frame with that single color instead of choosing a majority independently per frame.

The exact hard case at seed `0`, sample index `0` has three frames; each local majority is color 9 and the global-majority shortcut matches the Racket authority exactly. In a deterministic probe of seed `27001`, indices `0..99` per band, all 53/53 medium multi-frame inputs and 100/100 hard multi-frame inputs shared one majority color; easy emitted no multi-frame cases. By contrast, canonical training pair 0 requires color 3 inside one closed frame and color 8 inside another in the same grid (authority witness cells `(2,3)=3` and `(12,8)=8`). Thus the generator cannot teach the canonical per-frame independence visible in its own demonstrations.

Exact generated and canonical inputs, authority records, rival output, counts, source/rule hashes, and commands are in `checks/audit/7ef325b21961/semantic/analysis.json`. The generated output uses rule hash `450273ee54ad`; the canonical replay matches its retained expected output byte-for-byte.

The standalone checks found additional blockers: lint fails for missing `RULE_HASH`, singleton/dead axes, and an unprobed `position_bias`; defect lint flags all four helpful textures as byte-identical, degenerate textures in the ordinary domain, and canonical object-count drift (`canonical max_obj` median 38 versus generated range 16–28). Evidence is under `checks/audit/7ef325b21961/lint/` and `defect_lint/`. A repair should choose majority/minority colors independently per frame, include multi-frame different-majority examples, strengthen frame validation, remove or implement dead axes/textures, and pin the verified authority hash.

triage.reason: Both assigned source-bound audits read. Reproduced findings retained with their targets; bounded no-issue reports remain explicitly limited. No automatic repair or trajectory admission.
